messages:
Allie (People Ops): Quick kickoff - 'Gratitude Postcards + Microgrants' for Q2. Plan: collect short shoutout videos or a 1-line note Apr 6-20; send handwritten postcards and a $25 e-gift to submitters; pick 8 microgrant winners of $200. Need owners for vendor fulfillment, edits, and finance flow. Can we support global distribution without customs headaches?
Priya (Finance): Budget check: $25 * 150 = $3,750 + 8*$200 = $1,600 + printing/shipping ~ $700 => ~ $6,050. GL code 5124 ok. Note: some countries treat cards as taxable. I'll confirm thresholds with tax ops.
Marco (People Ops Ops): I can lead printing + fulfillment. Suggest using local printers: US/EU/APAC to avoid customs. Will get quotes by Apr 8.
Jen (People Ops): I'll own submission form + editing. Recommend 45s max per clip and written option for those uncomfortable on camera. Will draft Loom instructions.
Tom (Global Ops): Heads up: UK/DE may need reporting for non-cash gifts above certain values. Physical cards crossing borders risky. If we stick to e-gifts per region vendors we should be fine. Final recipient list needed by Apr 22 for timely disbursement.
HR-bot: Reminder: Sharing content in All-hands requires release form. Use template release_2026_v1 and opt-in checkbox.
Allie (People Ops): Great. Volunteers: Marco (fulfillment), Jen (editing), Priya (finance coord). I'll create project doc and calendar for review. Planning sync Wed Apr 10 10am PT. React with :raised_hands: if you can make the sync.
Jen (People Ops): :raised_hands: I'll run the edit queue and publish the submission guide.
Marco (People Ops Ops): :raised_hands: will post vendor estimates when available.
Priya (Finance): Looping tax ops now to confirm per-country treatment. Will update by Apr 9.
Allie (People Ops): Thanks all — posting project doc in #people-ops and adding milestone reminders.
